Hero.title: EHR, Rebuilt from Scratch.
Hero.subtitle: Not AI added to an EHR. An EHR designed on top of AI from day one.
Hero.subhero: Every vital sign, every lab, every note — alive with meaning, ready to act.
Hero.subheroDetail: Built on a clinical ontology engine, AI Native EHR turns raw medical data into a living knowledge graph. AI agents interpret context, detect patterns, and act — from real-time clinical decision support to automated coding and referral generation. Not a static database. A system that understands medicine the way clinicians do.

Problem.label: The Problem
Problem.title: Legacy EHRs Were Never Built for AI
Problem.subtitle: Current EHRs treat AI as an afterthought. Rigid data models and manual input workflows block meaningful AI integration.
Problem.stat3Label: of clinical time lost to admin tasks

Features.label: Core Features
Features.title: AI-first, from the ground up.
Features.subtitle: Not retrofitted onto legacy architecture. Designed around AI from the start.
Features.f1Desc: Speak or type. SOAP notes are generated automatically.
Features.f2Desc: Say 'Tylenol 500mg TID for 5 days' — get a fully structured, verified order.
Features.f3Desc: ICD/KCD codes recommended automatically from clinical documentation.
Features.f4Desc: Real-time alerts for drug interactions, contraindications, and guideline-based recommendations.
Features.f5Desc: AI distills complex charts into clear summaries. Quick context before every encounter.
Features.f6Desc: Referral and response letters drafted automatically from clinical context.
Features.f7Desc: Claims organized to match review criteria. Fewer denials.
Features.f8Desc: Patients book appointments, check results, and get medication reminders.

HowItWorks.label: How It Works
HowItWorks.title: Clinical workflow.
HowItWorks.subtitle: From voice input to approved record — AI handles the steps in between.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Talk to your patient. AI captures clinical details in real-time.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: The conversation becomes SOAP notes, orders, diagnosis codes, and billing data.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: Review what AI prepared. One tap to confirm. The doctor decides.
